parole.significato: a germander; any plant of genus Teucrium
parole.testo: From Middle Dutch gamander, gamandrea, from Medieval Latin gamandrea, earlier chamaedrys, from Ancient Greek χαμαίδρῡς (khamaídrūs).

parole.significato: Hesychasm (Eastern Orthodox mystical movement in late-mediaeval Byzantium)
parole.testo: Ultimately from Medieval Latin [Term?], from Ancient Greek [Term?].

parole.significato: a Hesychast (Eastern Orthodox mystic in late-mediaeval Byzantium)
parole.testo: Ultimately from Medieval Latin hesychasta, from Ancient Greek ἡσυχαστής (hēsukhastḗs), from ἡσυχάζειν (hēsukházein, “to be quiet”), from ἥσυχος (hḗsukhos, “quiet”).
From Medieval Latin macrocosmus, formed from Ancient Greek μακρός (makrós, “long, great, grand”) + κόσμος (kósmos, “universe, order”).
Borrowed from Medieval Latin pleura, from Ancient Greek πλευρᾱ́ (pleurā́).
